hero.title: Every patient. Every sample.
hero.body: MEDISOFT helps clinics and laboratories manage patients, laboratory orders, results, reports and daily operations from one secure and easy-to-use platform.

problem.title: Laboratory work shouldn’t depend on disconnected systems.
problem.body: Paper records, isolated spreadsheets and repeated data entry make every result slower and harder to trust.

features.title: Everything your team needs to move from order to answer.
features.body: A focused workspace for reception, laboratory staff and clinic managers.

items.title: Patient Management
items.body: Keep patient information, laboratory history and previous results in one place.

items.title: Laboratory Orders
items.body: Create laboratory orders and select required analyses quickly.

items.title: Result Management
items.body: Enter, review and validate laboratory results with confidence.

items.title: Reference Ranges
items.body: Automatically display configured ranges and flag abnormal results.

items.title: Laboratory Reports
items.body: Generate professional PDF and printable laboratory reports.

items.title: Billing
items.body: Manage analysis prices, payments and basic clinic billing.

workflow.eyebrow: A workflow your team can see
workflow.title: From registration to final report, without losing context.

security.title: Clinical data handled with clarity and control.
security.body: Role-based access, activity history and secure cloud access help your team work responsibly from anywhere.

cta.title: Give your laboratory a clearer working day.
cta.body: See how MEDISOFT can fit your clinic, your tests and your team.

footer.copy: Clinic and laboratory management, made clear.
